_comment: Names for the 00-area parameters, consumed by sysex_param_table_tex.py.
Every name here is the one Technics' own Reference Guide prints for that
address (pages 46-47); none is inferred. Store names in PLAIN text --
the generator escapes & and _ for LaTeX itself.
confidence ESTABLISHED = published or stated by the instrument's own screen;
LIKELY = a hard match on value range or bit count, printed with a dagger.
